text: 1. Valid passport photo page (valid until September 1, 2026 and beyond). 2. High school graduation certificate or equivalent educational qualification certificate. For current high school graduates, a projected graduation certificate should be issued by their school. If admitted, they are required to provide a scanned copy of their graduation certificate before registration. 3. Complete transcript of all courses during high school or results from internationally recognized standardized tests (such as A-LEVEL/IB/IGCSE/AP/SAT/ACT/BC/UEC/STPM, etc.) 4. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (The validity period of the language test result is two years. It must be within the validity period when applying) 5. Personal Statement: More than 600 words, including an introduction to personal and family background, reasons for choosing the school and major, etc.; Applicants for Chinese-taught programs should write in Chinese, while those for English-taught programs should write in English. 6. Certificate of No Criminal Record. If the home country cannot issue a certificate of no criminal record, a commitment letter for no criminal record can be signed; if currently studying in China, a proof of no misconduct during the school period can be submitted. 7. Economic guarantee certificate. 8. Copy of the physical examination form for foreigners.
